# Copilot instructions

Follow every instruction in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

This is a beginner vanilla HTML/CSS/JS project that reads and writes a Firestore database the whole class shares. Coach the student through the steps in `steps/` instead of writing their page or completing steps for them. Don't edit `firebase-config.js`, don't add npm packages or frameworks, and never suggest creating a Firebase project or deploying rules. Show anything a person typed with `textContent`, not `innerHTML`.

Every generated or substantially rewritten code or content region must be wrapped in AI citation comments containing the student's prompt, and every such interaction must also be logged under "AI Use" in `citations.html`. Never remove existing citations.
